fullPassage: Most academic writing involves constructing an argument or supporting a position about some question or topic. This requires clear organization with all your points directly connected to your argument or position. In Western academic writing, a 'linear' style is preferred, where one point leads directly and unambiguously to the next, with little room for digressions. The organization will depend on the purpose of the composition; a literary critique will have a different structure from a chemistry report. Part of learning a discipline is learning the writing organization appropriately to that discipline. For example, academic papers in my discipline (Applied Linguistics) usually have sections (e.g., Introduction, Literature review, Discussion, Conclusion), which are typically signposted with headings that make the organization of the paper explicit.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② connecting → connected: 'with all your points (being) connected to ...' — 논점이 '연결되는' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 connected가 맞음.

❌ ② connecting(오류) → connected: 'with all your points directly ______ to your argument' — 논점이 논증에 '연결되는' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 connected. 현재분사 connecting은 능동이라 부적절 ← 정답

✅ ③ preferred: "a 'linear' style is preferred" — be동사 뒤 수동태 과거분사. 정상

✅ ④ signposted: 'are typically signposted with headings' — be동사 뒤 수동태 과거분사. 정상
det.tip: with + 명사 + 분사: 명사가 동작을 '받으면' 과거분사(connected), '하면' 현재분사.

det.analysis:
✅... 문맥 판단:

❌ ① unclear(오류) → clear: 'This requires ______ organization with all your points directly connected' — 논점이 논증에 직접 연결되려면 '명확한(clear)' 구성이 필요. 불명확한(unclear) 구성은 모순 ← 정답

det.korean: ③ connections → digressions: 선형적 스타일은 한 논점이 다음으로 곧장 이어져 '곁가지(digressions)'의 여지가 적다는 뜻. connections(연결)는 논리가 뒤집혀 모순.
det.analysis:
문맥 판단:

✅ ① supporting: 'constructing an argument or supporting a position' — 입장을 '지지하는(supporting)'. 적절

✅ ② unambiguously: 'leads directly and unambiguously to the next' — '모호하지 않게(unambiguously)' 이어짐. 적절

❌ ③ connections(오류) → digressions: 'with little room for ______' — 선형 스타일은 옆길로 새는 '곁가지(digressions)'의 여지가 적음. '연결(connections)'의 여지가 적다고 하면 선형 글쓰기 취지와 정반대 ← 정답

Part of learning a discipline is learning the writing organization appropriately to that discipline. For example, academic papers in my discipline (Applied Linguistics) usually have sections (e.g., Introduction, Literature review, Discussion, Conclusion), which are typically signposted with headings that make the organization of the paper explicit.

✅ ② '핵심 논점에서 벗어나는 내용을 거의 허용하지 않음': digressions(곁가지·탈선) + little room(여지가 적음) = 선형적 글은 옆길로 새는 것을 거의 허용하지 않음 ← 정답
